hooks.name: rustfmt-on-save
hooks.description: Formatter: formats with cargo fmt when the agent saves a .rs file

hooks.name: clippy-on-save
hooks.description: Linter + type check: every .rs save must pass clippy (including the compile check) with zero warnings

hooks.name: clippy-on-stop
hooks.description: At the end of a turn, the agent keeps fixing clippy warnings and errors if there are any

hooks.name: tests-on-stop
hooks.description: Done condition: all tests (unit, QC, scenarios) must pass at the end of a turn. If they fail, the agent keeps fixing them
